messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 🔴 | Elevated 5xx + timeouts detected across gateway and inference runtime after recent deploy. p95 jumped to ~1.8s, p99 to ~6.3s. Paging #eng-sre and #eng-runtime — creating thread 3419998888
maya (oncall): On it. Starting triage. Which deploy? @deploy-bot any recent rollouts?
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: canary ID canary-20260317-12:15 -> promoted 12:23. Changes: runtime kernels + kv-cache eviction tuning. CI: green.
aj: Seeing surge of 502s at gateway and 504s from runtime. Error rate up ~8x in last 5m. Traces show repeated "context deadline exceeded" from runtime handlers.
leo: Pulling logs from runtime-primary-3, tail:
```
2026-03-17T12:25:31Z WARN kvcache evict took 110ms
2026-03-17T12:25:33Z ERR write timeout context deadline exceeded
2026-03-17T12:25:34Z ERR inference stalled kvcache miss
```
carla: Customer impact: several enterprise customers reporting timeouts in chat flows. Support queue growing. @support-john can you surface top 3 affected customers?
support-john: Top3: AcmeCorp, FinMark, HealthGrid. All on Dedicated. Opening incident support channel and notifying CSMs. ETA for customer comms: ~30m once we confirm root cause.
maya (oncall): Can we validate whether the kv-cache eviction tweak correlates? Any quick config rollback possible?
aj: I can flip the eviction flag on canary back, but promotion already occurred. Options: (1) roll traffic back to canary, (2) immediate rollback to previous stable. Rollback is fastest to reduce customer impact.
leo: Agreed. Runtime CPU shows GC-like pauses and p99 latency aligns with eviction windows. Recommend rollback.
maya (oncall): Initiating rollback now. @deploy-bot kick rollback to stable-20260317-11:40.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: rolling update to stable-20260317-11:40 in us-west-1. Estimated finish: ~4m. Will post progress.
aj: Also throttling routing now — diverting 60% to standby region and applying temporary CB at gateway for heavy requests. config snippet: `gateway.circuit_breaker.threshold=200`
carla: :thumbsup: Hold off external comms until rollback verifies improvement. Support to prep postmortem comms template.
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: us-west-1 3/5 pods updated; 5xx rate down ~40% in canary telemetry.
maya (oncall): Telemetry trending better — p95 down to ~420ms, p99 to ~950ms. Keep rollback running and monitor for residual spikes.
leo: Confirmed kv-cache eviction flag reverted on updated pods. Observability link: https://telemetry/redwood/incident/3419998888 (internal).
support-john: Support queue trending down. Outreach to AcmeCorp initiated; no escalations yet.
maya (oncall): Rollback complete. System back on stable-20260317-11:40. Marking incident mitigated for immediate customer impact. We'll observe for 1 hour then run postmortem.
carla: Assigning postmortem owners: leo (owner), aj (deploy), maya (oncall). Draft due EOD tomorrow. Include rollback triggers and rollout guard checks.
maya (oncall): Handing off to ops-nora for night watch — ops-nora please ack and continue monitoring for the next 2 shifts.
ops-nora: Ack. Monitoring dashboards, tightened alert thresholds, will escalate if error_rate > 2% sustained over 5m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE ✅ | Mitigated. Suspected root cause: kv-cache eviction tuning in runtime release. Postmortem scheduled. Thread closed at 3419999000
